GEN 6:2.why: Keep as a note: “angels” is written over an erasure, and the reading and hand remain uncertain. The recorded reading is over an erasure with an uncertain A attribution (A?vid). Its qualification needs resolution before the English alternative is promoted. Brenton prints the note so in every printing (1844 p. 30; 1879 p. 23; 1900 p. 19).

swete.reading: ἄγγελοι sup ras A?vid

2KI 3:21#2.why: Keep as a note: “and above” lacks a stated threshold. The apparatus records ἐπάνω A where Brenton’s body has they said, Ho; Brenton’s note gives καὶ ἐπάνα in every printing (1844 p. 426; 1879 p. 507; 1884 p. 474; 1900 p. 503), his own spelling, so the note keeps it. Establish the integrated English threshold before changing the body.
